patch.value: Enforce a real coverage gate by running tests against TypeScript sources

Baseline measured 2026-07-29 across two source files: index.ts at 73.08 line, 78.30 branch, 73.03 function; projects.ts at 97.00 line, 81.41 branch, 100.00 function. All files aggregate: 76.14 line, 78.93 branch, 75.74 function. Thresholds pinned at the measured floor (76/78/75) so the numbers can only ratchet up. 172 tests, 0 failures.

Removed the probe and re-ran: exit code 0, 2 source files reported. The presence check is not vacuous.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Node omits never-loaded files from its coverage report rather than reporting them at zero, so a threshold flag alone is satisfiable by narrowing what the suite imports. Any coverage gate must reconcile the report against the source tree.

patch.value: Tests moved onto TypeScript sources and scripts/coverage-gate.ts wired into release:check and CI.
A coverage gate runs in the release check and in CI on both supported Node lines, reports against TypeScript sources, and fails when a source file is untested or a threshold regresses.

npm run check passes. npm run coverage passes with 172 tests, both source files present in the report, at 76.14 line, 78.93 branch and 75.74 function coverage. A negative control adding an untested source file made the gate exit 1 and name that file, so the presence check is not vacuous. Thresholds pinned at 76/78/75. The Node 22 CI leg is unobserved until the PR runs.
Coverage gate landed and locally verified; the Node 22 CI leg is unobserved until the pull request runs.
